description: R6 step-1 + step-2 probe: extract Frobenius eigenvalues Frob_p(q) from the Habiro cyclotomic expansion of each atom's Markov trace by evaluating at u = ζ_{2p}. The cyclotomic Pochhammer (u; u)_m vanishes once m ≥ 2p, so the sum truncates after a finite number of terms. The Galois norm N(Frob_p) = Σ_{k coprime to 2p} Frob_p(ζ_{2p}^k) is verified to be a rational integer (residual < 1e-6) on every (atom, prime) where the truncation lands inside the on-disk Habiro data — finite-place reciprocity check.
